name: SPEED_LIMIT_CHANGED_AHEAD_YELLOW_LONG
notes: Department of State Growth (formerly DIER) standard drawing, black line-work sheet; every dimension from the sheet unless stated. Series/heights as the sheet's letter-type note; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing, so widths differ from the sheet's figures where its spacing is wider (the TAS sheets' 'medium'/'75%' spacing runs about 7% wider than AS 1744 normal spacing). Sheet G/10/457 'General temporary sign T1-101' (2000), table row T1-101B: A 1800 x B 1170, black legend on Class 1 yellow, 'border: outer corner radius 30mm', N 25 read as the border width (double line drawn). SPEED LIMIT 160 'EN' (normal spacing) cap top J 185, SPEED D 744 / gap I 120 / LIMIT O 576; CHANGED and AHEAD 160 'EM' (medium spacing) tops 505 / 825 (M 160 between lines), widths F 1200 / H 880 (E/G margins). AS 1744 normal spacing fits the DN line (SPEED/LIMIT) and runs about 7-9% narrower than the sheet's DM figures. The sheet draws one generic sign for both rows: the overlay check uses the same drawing for A and B.
